basis.finding: Abseil 20250512.1 CallOnceImpl changes control to running, invokes the callable, and only after normal return exchanges done and wakes waiters; exact source has no exception reset or waiter wake path.

Protobuf v36.0 GetMetadataImpl calls absl::call_once around AssignDescriptorsOnceInnerCall. AddDescriptors sets DescriptorTable::is_initialized=true before AddDescriptorsImpl performs descriptor-pool, message-factory, extension and reflection registration; AssignMessageDescriptor mutates class data and allocates Reflection objects.

The real Windows allocation sweep fails at ArenaStringPtr::Mutable during AssignDescriptorsOnceInnerCall and the subsequent same-descriptor attempt hangs in SpinLockWait/CallOnceImpl. The hang dump includes two worker waiter threads.

why_not_runtime_fix: Caller-side catch cannot reset private absl::once_flag safely or know which generated descriptor tables and registrations were partially mutated.
Resetting only once state can expose partially registered DescriptorPool, MessageFactory, default-instance and reflection state.
Routing around measureProtobufOperation changes the frozen payload-budget oracle and does not prove normal encoding equivalence.

release_path: Create versioned source patches and producer contract changes with exact source hashes.
Build Abseil then Protobuf from verified archives using tools/semantic/build_runtime.py; never modify installed SDK in place.
Run SDK unit/reproducibility/smoke plus ONCE-OOM-RETURN, ONCE-WAITER-2, PROTO-PARTIAL-STATE, PROTO-RETRY-BYTES and FULL-SWEEP.
Publish an immutable Semantic SDK release set and candidate lock-only PR through the existing workflow; releaseTag, releaseSetId and indexSha256 must change.
Resolve the candidate through setup_build_environment.py and offline resolution; rebuild Axiom consumers and rerun P32 obligations.
